name: Twynflower
source:
Your name is Myosotis, and you have borne a curse for your beloved twin sister Magnolia for years. You had the strength to bear it, once, when you had her beside you. It was supposed to be the two of you, together.

But you've let the curse consume you, haven't you? And she's drifted away from you despite everything. You've asked her to meet you once more at the childhood home you shared, and she came.

Maybe this time things will be different.
But whichever choices you make, I'll be waiting for you...

[from [url=https://morimem022.itch.io/twynflower]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的名字叫Myosotis，多年来你一直为你心爱的双胞胎妹妹Magnolia背负着诅咒。当你有她在你身边时，你曾经有力量承受它。本来应该是你们两个在一起的。

但你已经让诅咒吞噬了你，不是吗？尽管如此，她还是疏远了你。你邀请她在你们童年时共同居住的家里再次见到你，她来了。

也许这一次情况会有所不同。
但无论你做出什么选择，我都会等你……

[来自[url=https://morimem022.itch.io/twynflower]itch.io[/url]]
